behavior_definitions.GIT-001: Default history argv is exact and shell-free.
behavior_definitions.GIT-002: Nonempty raw log options use literal ASCII-space splitting, including empty and quoted tokens.
behavior_definitions.GIT-003: Working-tree/staged argv and final dot pathspec are exact; untracked files are absent.
behavior_definitions.GIT-004: stdout is parsed as bytes into ordered files/hunks; asynchronous parse truncation needs a safe disposition.
behavior_definitions.GIT-005: Raw contains only compacted added-line bytes and StartLine is hunk NewPosition.
behavior_definitions.GIT-006: No-newline, hunk deletion, and whole-file deletion distinctions remain exact.
behavior_definitions.GIT-007: Git logical paths remain byte preserving.
behavior_definitions.GIT-008: Nonarchive binaries skip and filename-recognized binary archives scan the selected blob.
behavior_definitions.GIT-009: History uses commit:path and empty-commit diff archives use index :path.
behavior_definitions.GIT-010: History metadata and diff-only zero metadata are exact.
behavior_definitions.GIT-011: The source-level commit allowlist attempt is a no-op.
behavior_definitions.GIT-013: stderr whitelist and one-generic-issue behavior have an explicit safe overflow disposition.
behavior_definitions.GIT-014: Rust must not silently lose child exit, parser, kill, wait, or reap outcomes.
behavior_definitions.GIT-015: Cancellation stops process/blob/archive work and joins helpers before return.
behavior_definitions.GIT-016: Remote discovery argv, directory, and no-platform behavior are exact.
behavior_definitions.GIT-017: Remote normalization, userinfo removal, no-remote errors, and first-remote selection are exact.
behavior_definitions.GIT-018: Platform parsing and host inference use the closed pinned mapping.
behavior_definitions.GIT-019: SCM links preserve pinned template/path/anchor behavior.
behavior_definitions.GIT-023: GIT-INT-001..007 use isolated complete copies and preserve shared fixture bytes.
